question:
If 'A' stands for '÷' 'B' stands for '×', 'C' stands for '+' and 'D' stands for, '-' what will come in place of the question mark (?) in the following equation?

13 B 145 A 29 C 69 D 17 = ?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f17fe402f98bb01e6c434026861e42229a2db5fdddb9ac339c012f7a2b73afa8.png] 

On replacing the letters with the mathematical signs, we get

⇒ 13 × 145 ÷ 29 + 69 - 17 = ?
